strengths: FOR UPDATE row lock on the workspace precedes the empty-count guard (columns.ts:58-66), correctly serializing concurrent applies under READ COMMITTED per the sandwich-context mandate

recordActivity runs on the transaction client atomically with the inserts (columns.ts:94); publishEvent is post-commit and best-effort wrapped in try/catch (columns.ts:103-110), exactly matching the spec ordering

is_signable/signable_assignee_id are hardcoded to false/null in the INSERT (columns.ts:79) and never read by the validator — forward-compatible signable-not-persisted invariant guaranteed at two layers
Positions use i * POSITION_GAP from a zero base (columns.ts:83), avoiding integer positions per the fractional-positioning rule

Palette (COLUMN_COLORS, isValidColumnColor) cleanly extracted into validators/column.ts and re-imported by both batch and the unchanged PATCH/POST handlers — single source of truth as the OBJECTIVE required
validateColumnName reused; NodeNext .js import extensions throughout; PATCH single-done block (columns.ts:196-274) and columns schema left untouched

TDD honored (separate validator test/impl and integration test/impl commits) with conventional commit messages; unit tests cover empty-array, bad-color, >1-done, blank-title, and bad-wipLimit rejection plus the valid 5-column accept path

Correction commit 6ee3ea8 returns a 500 on tx failure instead of hanging, isolates batch tests to workspace 99 with scoped cleanup (no destructive TRUNCATE / pool.end), and wraps ROLLBACK defensively against an already-aborted tx

issues.description: Unused import 'afterEach' in the integration test (imported but never called). Cosmetic only — server noUnusedLocals is client-scoped per CLAUDE.md, so it is not a build break. Inherited from the plan's own template.

The atomicity test was changed in correction 6ee3ea8 to fail via a mocked recordActivity rejection rather than the spec's literal 'insert fails on column 3' (Example C). Both exercise the identical catch -> ROLLBACK path so rollback coverage is preserved, but the specific mid-INSERT failure point is no longer directly simulated.
